themes.title: Big pharma's Q2 shows AI R&D is funded by real cash flow
themes.description: Lilly's Q2 revenue hit $23.0B (+48%) on Mounjaro and Zepbound, beating estimates and lifting FY26 guidance to $85–87B; Novartis reaffirmed full-year guidance on Q2 sales growth. Neither needs its AI platform bets (Isomorphic, Chai Discovery, the NVIDIA co-innovation lab) to pay off to keep funding them at scale.

themes.title: The multiomics picks-and-shovels layer had its best week of the year
themes.description: Illumina, Tempus AI and Guardant Health all beat Q2 estimates and raised full-year guidance in the same 48 hours. Separately, Abbott's ~$21B all-cash acquisition of Exact Sciences (closed Mar 23) shows real M&A premiums flow to companies with actual test volumes and reimbursement — not to unproven AI platform narratives.

themes.title: The clinic is the real test now
themes.description: Insilico formally initiated the Phase III GENESIS-IPF trial for rentosertib on Jul 7 (320 patients, 47 China centers); Isomorphic's ISM8969 cleared the FDA for human trials in January and remains on track for Isomorphic's first clinical trials by year-end 2026. Zero AI-discovered drugs have reached full FDA approval.

themes.title: Public AI-biotech names swing hard on single data points
themes.description: Recursion's Q2 revenue missed by ~47% yet shares rose ~11% on a Genentech milestone and positive trial data landing the same day; Generate Biomedicines missed Q2 estimates but picked up a reiterated Buy from Piper Sandler the next day. Eikon's lock-up expired Aug 4 right after two board directors resigned, with shares now ~48% below its IPO price.

private_watchlist.name: Isomorphic Labs
private_watchlist.note: AlphaFold 3 lineage; Thrive Capital-led round adds MGX, Temasek, CapitalG & UK Sovereign AI Fund alongside Alphabet/GV. ISM8969 cleared FDA for human trials Jan 28, 2026 — the oncology candidate CEO Demis Hassabis says will anchor Isomorphic's first clinical trials by year-end 2026, a year later than his original 2025 target.

private_watchlist.name: Insilico Medicine
private_watchlist.note: Formally initiated the Phase III GENESIS-IPF trial for rentosertib on Jul 7, 2026 — 320 patients, 52 weeks, 47 centers across China; the Phase IIa data behind it (published in Nature Medicine) showed +98.4 mL forced vital capacity improvement at 12 weeks on the 60mg arm. Still the field's clearest clinical proof point; listed on HKEX (Dec 2025, $292M IPO).

private_watchlist.name: Xaira Therapeutics
private_watchlist.note: Launched X-Cell, its first virtual cell model (4.9B parameters, trained on the X-Atlas/Pisces dataset), in March 2026. Built out its clinical leadership Jul 6 — Ci Chu to Chief Discovery Officer, Bo Wang to Chief AI Scientist, plus a new SVP of Translational Science & Early Clinical Development — a tell that it's moving from platform-building toward actually running trials.

private_watchlist.name: NewLimit
private_watchlist.note: Epigenetic reprogramming for longevity (Founders Fund, Lilly Ventures, Jun 2026); cites a prototype that reverses aging in human liver cells, targeting clinical entry as early as 2027. Retro Biosciences also notable at a $1.8B valuation with an Alzheimer's trial underway.

bear_case.title: Biology still fails in the clinic
bear_case.description: Zero AI-discovered drugs have reached full FDA approval — rentosertib's Phase III initiation (Jul 7) is the field's furthest milestone, not a finish line. Recursion's Q2 revenue fell to $7.7M from $19.2M, missing estimates by ~47%; the stock only rose because of a Genentech milestone and a favorable Phase 2 readout landing the same day. Revenue and share price are telling two different stories.

bear_case.title: Catalyst-driven volatility
bear_case.description: These stocks trade on announcements; between catalysts they drift and dilute. Generate Biomedicines missed Q2 estimates and widened its loss, yet Piper Sandler reiterated Buy the next day. Eikon's (EIKN) lock-up expired Aug 4 right after two board directors resigned — shares now sit ~48% below the Feb 2026 IPO price with no clinical catalyst yet to offset the overhang.

bear_case.title: Platform-value skepticism
bear_case.description: If pharma can license AI tools cheaply (or build in-house), platform companies may capture less value than valuations imply. The clearest data point this year points the other way for tooling, not platforms: Abbott paid ~$21B in cash for Exact Sciences — real test volumes and reimbursed CPT codes, not an AI story. Compare that to Anthropic's ~$400M acquihire of 10-person Coefficient Bio (Apr 2026): biotech AI capability itself can be bought cheaply, which is a soft signal against paying platform-scale premiums for AI-native drug discovery names specifically.

bear_case.title: Rate sensitivity
bear_case.description: Long-duration biotech cash flows are highly sensitive to rates; macro can swamp fundamentals regardless of platform progress.

stance.basis: Weights are a share of a hypothetical 100% sleeve for THIS SECTOR only — not a share of your portfolio. Core and Speculative names carry the weight; Watch and Avoid deliberately carry 0% because the point of those groups is that you are not holding them yet.

positions.name: Eli Lilly
positions.note: Q2 revenue hit $23.0B (+48%) on Mounjaro and Zepbound, beating estimates and lifting FY26 guidance to $85–87B — cash flows from an actual blockbuster franchise fund the AI-discovery programmes for free.

positions.name: Novartis
positions.note: Q2 sales +3% to $14.4B with guidance reaffirmed; deep AI partnerships across the pipeline are backed by pharma economics rather than a platform story.

positions.name: NVIDIA
positions.note: BioNeMo and the Lilly co-innovation lab make it the compute layer for nearly every AI-biotech platform on this page. It also sits in your AI, Robotics and Quantum sleeves — don't double-count the exposure across sleeves.

positions.name: Illumina
positions.note: Q2 beat on both lines (EPS $1.31 vs $1.23 est., revenue +9.5%) with FY26 EPS guidance raised to $5.30–5.40 and 95+ NovaSeq X placements — the sequencing incumbent monetizes every experiment regardless of which drug-discovery platform wins, though low-cost sequencing competitors remain a long-run risk.

positions.name: Schrödinger
positions.note: Q2 beat with ACV +27% and a swing to $6.0M net income plus the new Bunsen AI co-scientist — software revenue provides a floor the other AI-native names don't have, but the co-founded therapeutics pipeline is still where the real return has to come from.

positions.name: Recursion
positions.note: Q2 revenue missed by ~47% and fell by more than half year-over-year; the stock only rallied on a Genentech milestone and a favorable REC-4881 readout, not on the business itself.

positions.name: Relay Therapeutics
positions.note: Net loss widened 20% in Q2, but $910.9M in cash funds runway into 2029 and the zovegalisib + atirmociclib triplet gives a concrete Phase 3 timeline (early 2027) — genuine science, binary readouts ahead.

positions.name: Generate Biomedicines
positions.note: Q2 loss came in wider than expected and revenue missed, but Novartis advancing a platform-designed biologic into preclinical is real third-party validation of the generative-protein-design approach; GB-0895's Phase 3 asthma readouts are still 12+ months out.

positions.name: Quantum-Si
positions.note: The proteomics layer is the least mature, highest-upside part of the multiomics stack; the new Cell Signaling Technology partnership (Jun 10) is a real commercial step, but this is still a micro-cap, pre-commercial-scale bet sized accordingly.

positions.name: 908 Devices
positions.note: Metabolomics instrument layer with a small, negative-earnings business (Q2 results due Aug 11, consensus -$0.14 EPS on ~$15.4M revenue) — smallest position on the page for a reason.

positions.name: Tempus AI
positions.note: Genuinely the most direct public expression of the multiomics flywheel thesis — Q2 revenue +22% to $382.5M with the company's first meaningful net income — but a growth-and-data-network story like this is priced for continued perfection; wait for a better entry rather than chase the print.

positions.name: Guardant Health
positions.note: Q2 revenue +44% to $335M with guidance raised, but EPS still missed (-$0.42 vs -$0.39 est.) — the growth is real, the path to profitability and durable reimbursement is not yet proven at this valuation.

positions.name: Eikon Therapeutics
positions.note: Two board directors resigned effective Jul 31 right as the Aug 4 lock-up expiry opened the door to insider selling, and shares already sit ~48% below the $18 IPO price with no clinical catalyst yet to offset the overhang — too much near-term technical risk to own here regardless of the underlying live-cell imaging science.
